description: A farmyard on a misty morning. A young woman with a long blond braid, a denim shirt, orange dungarees and yellow rubber boots walks away across the wet concrete carrying two metal buckets of milk, which splash onto the ground as she turns and smiles. A line of black-and-white cows walks beside her towards a metal shed, where a farmer in green overalls stands at the open door. A collie trots past milk churns, and a steel milk tank and milking stalls stand by the shed, with green fields behind.
